sections.title: Introduction to Causal Inference for Educational Research
sections.description: Offers applied introduction to methods of causal inference for evaluation research; introduces students to statistical models for causal inference based on randomized controlled trials and observational studies; includes discussion of special topics such as replication and generalizability that touch upon issues related to implementation and implications of experimental/quasi-experimental research.
